versions.changelog:
multi-project-quote-board v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Generate structured, bilingual (Chinese/English) self-contained HTML quote comparison dashboards and matching Excel (6 sheets), with unified data source and rendering logic.
- Designed for multi-project, multi-supplier tendering with strict data/render separation and zero code changes for new projects, suppliers, or spec changes.
- Built-in denoised templates/examples and data integrity checks; highlights lowest quotes meeting lead time, project-by-project, with zero cross-project aggregation.
- Comprehensive documentation includes usage boundaries, architectural rationale, extension guidance, and rigorous do-not-cross policies for data integrity.
- Supports supplier/terms/follow-up expansion via single-source DATA LAYER, with clear field definitions and robust changelog/provisioning instructions.
- Requires only standard Python3 library for HTML; openpyxl (and optionally Pillow) for Excel with image embedding.
